profile.about:
Passionate IT professional with a strong educational foundation and continuous learning mindset. Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in IT at ICST while building practical experience through hands-on projects.

I am interested in full-stack development, data analytics, artificial intelligence, and cloud computing — and in using technology to solve real-world problems.

My goal is to bridge technical innovation and business needs, contributing to projects that make a difference.
